name: TRAE Plugin
desc: Trae's coding assistant plugin for VS Code and JetBrains
desc_zh: 装进 VS Code 和 JetBrains 的 TRAE 编程助手插件
solves: Your team will not switch editors for AI help. Install the plugin, keep keybindings and settings, and get completion, chat and fixes in place.
solves_zh: 团队不愿为了 AI 换编辑器。装上插件，快捷键和配置都不动，补全、问答和修复就在手边。
best_for: When GoLand or PyCharm is already the daily editor and a code review is due.
best_for_zh: 平时就在 GoLand 或 PyCharm 里写代码，今天要过一遍评审，直接在原编辑器里问它。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://docs.trae.cn/llms.txt (section 'TRAE Plugin'), https://www.trae.cn/p）。 Same installable plugin under three names: it entered the JetBrains Marketplace as the MarsCode plugin (earliest listed version 1.0.3.0, file MarsCode-1.0.3.0.zip, 2024-05-06), the official changelog records the brand upgrade to 'Trae AI' on 2025-04-15, and the current docs call it 'TraeCode Plugin' while trae.cn/plugin calls it 'TRAE Plugin'. Supports VS Code, JetBrains IDEs and Android Studio. Not in the 2026-05-07 window: proposed as a backfill. The version-history endpoint returns only the 20 most recent builds by default; the full 93-entry history (and the 2024-05-06 earliest build) needs the size=200 query string used in the evidence URL. The JetBrains marketplace vendor is the verified organisation 'marscode' (vendor id 11050, url https://www.marscode.com/). 入库核对（2026-11-25）：这个插件在 2024-05-06 以 MarsCode 插件的名字上架 JetBrains 市场，2025-04-15 官方更新日志写「品牌升级为 Trae AI」。 按账本的改名规则，新名字的档案记新名字首次启用的日子；旧名的档案是账本里的 marscode。 首次公开日期来源：https://docs.trae.cn/plugin_changelog
